description: Observed during People permissions PR1 (zaq-6pa) browser validation at 390x844: existing shared BOLayout header controls overflow document width, including on People tab without matrix. Screenshots under test/e2e/test-results/people-People-permissions--0202f-yboard-and-mobile-scrolling-journeys-chromium/. No implementation in PR1.
title: [zaq-gyv] Fix shared BO header mobile overflow
